transport_notes.charge_transport: Charge carriers move; the electric field biases their transport.
transport_notes.energy_transport: Electromagnetic energy transport is represented by the Poynting vector.
transport_notes.symmetry: Broken inversion symmetry can permit second-order rectification or shift current.
transport_notes.no_go: At global equilibrium, detailed balance removes sustained directed work.

anchors.name: Energy ledger
anchors.criterion: source power must cover electrical output, rejected heat, storage change, and auxiliaries

anchors.name: Non-equilibrium port
anchors.criterion: a maintained temperature, photon, chemical, mechanical, or nuclear free-energy gradient is mandatory

anchors.name: Charge continuity
anchors.criterion: no persistent charge accumulation outside specified capacitive states

anchors.name: Electrical stress
anchors.criterion: creepage, clearance, insulation, field crowding, and switching transients remain below certified limits

anchors.name: Heat rejection
anchors.criterion: all non-converted input plus electronics loss reaches the environment under worst-case ambient conditions

anchors.name: Hot-stack stability
anchors.criterion: oxidation, interdiffusion, agglomeration, phase drift, and thermal expansion remain bounded

anchors.name: Cold-cell stability
anchors.criterion: TPV junction temperature, dark current, contacts, and photon-recycling surfaces remain within tested limits

anchors.name: Radiation compatibility
anchors.criterion: displacement damage, ionization, contamination, and source containment are institutionally certified when applicable

anchors.name: Current-density life
anchors.criterion: electromigration, contact heating, and cyclic fatigue remain below lifetime damage budgets

anchors.name: Hermeticity
anchors.criterion: vacuum or inert atmosphere, getters, seals, feedthroughs, and corrosion barriers survive the declared life

anchors.name: Power quality and protection
anchors.criterion: 220 V RMS, 60 Hz output remains within harmonic, isolation, overcurrent, ground-fault, and safe-shutdown limits

anchors.name: Receipt and manufacturability
anchors.criterion: every layer, process window, measurement, uncertainty, and failure test is traceable and reproducible
